name: What is the process for a basement custom design project?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for a basement custom design project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process for a basement custom design project typically starts with an initial consultation to discuss your vision and budget. This is followed by design development, where plans and material selections are finalized. Once permits are secured, construction begins, involving demolition, framing, utility installation, insulation, drywall, and finishing touches. Regular communication ensures the project stays on track and meets your expectations.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, design, permit acquisition, construction (framing, utilities, finishes), and ongoing communication.
